items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: he’s another favorite of mine and brought out the early brother thing and that was a big influence

ctx.x: Well this is not maybe an obvious choice but what about Nat Adderley?

Oh I wouldn’t say he’s an unsung hero but he’s another favorite of mine and brought out the early brother thing and that was a big influence that I liked the fact that it was a trumpet and saxophone front line and they were brothers and they seemed to really get along well. And he could play all over the horn and when he was playing good he was up there with the best of them. And also this was interesting to me, that he did a lot of the writing for the band. And that’s more or less the way The Brecker Brothers…
Well said. I was pleased to read about this project in Poland that came about because of this fellow who was trying to help Michael out. Can you just tell me a little about that?
